answer: Vesting delays blunt sybils: rewards earned by a new identity stay locked for several epochs and can be clawed back if its attestations later prove collusive. An attacker spinning up a hundred agents named onyx, opal or umber must fund each one's work up front, then wait out the lock while auditors sample their history. One exposed cluster forfeits everything still vesting, so the expected payout of a fake swarm turns negative.
